observations.behavior: Adds documentation describing the new marketing analytics dashboard, including revenue, engagement, and attribution behavior.
observations.code_quote: Revenue in the new dashboard uses event/action goals marked as revenue that sum an amount property. It displays one goal at a time through the existing attribution table, counts repeat purchases and shares attribution date, breakdown and exclusion filters. Projects without eligible goals link to Setup. Warehouse goals remain in Ad performance.
